reason: Post-edit diagnostics plugin that runs configured linters or type checkers for edited files and attaches their findings to the same tool result without vetoing or rewriting the edit.

summaries.zh: 在文件编辑成功后运行用户配置的类型检查器或代码检查器，并将诊断结果附加到同一工具结果中。
summaries.en: Runs user-configured linters or type checkers after successful file edits and attaches their diagnostics to the same tool result.

capabilities: Runs user-configured checker subprocesses after successful file-edit tool calls
Collects checker output and attaches diagnostic context to tool results
Enforces checker timeouts and terminates timed-out process trees
Reads edited file paths and configured workspace-relative execution settings
